rules.name: Year-over-year swing
rules.help: Latest full year's change vs the year before. In adaptive mode the thresholds are this series' own 85th / 95th percentile of past swings (never below 'medium' / 'high'), so volatile series only fire when unusually volatile. mode: adaptive or fixed.

rules.name: Year-to-date pace
rules.help: This year's straight-line run-rate vs last full year, once at least min_fraction of the year has passed. A slowdown of at least 'medium' raises a low alert.

rules.name: Trend break
rules.help: Latest full year vs a model fitted without it, in standard errors (z). 1.645 ≈ outside the 90% band (medium); 2.326 ≈ outside the 98% band (high). The regime-change detector.

rules.name: Acceleration
rules.help: Short-window annual growth exceeds long-window growth by at least medium_pts (0.15 = 15 points). The reverse raises a low 'slowing' alert.

rules.name: Stale data
rules.help: Series not updated for this many days. Most sources publish annually, so ~15 months.

rules.name: Bet ready to resolve
rules.help: An open bet is past its resolve-by date, or the data that settles it has arrived.

rules.name: You vs the model
rules.help: Your probability differs from the trend model's by at least this many percentage points.

rules.name: Bet without a probability
rules.help: An open bet has no probability, so it can't be scored.

rules.name: Signpost arrived
rules.help: A signpost was marked 'arrived'. Re-plan trigger.

rules.name: Signpost not reviewed
rules.help: A signpost's state or evidence hasn't changed in this many days.
